prompt: Create a polished Chinese technical blog cover, wide landscape 16:9, explaining distributed transactions visually. Solid blue connector lines join each island to the hub. Small numbered badges on two illustrative path labels read "1 准备" and "2 提交", with green check status badges by service islands. The hub, service islands and labels must remain legible at article cover size.
